# std/gt

> > : greater than

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/gt.pkg) · translated by [bintables/gt](../bintables/gt.md)

Greater than: 1 or 0 (signed comparison).

```
print 2 > 3     // 0
```

Infix, precedence 40, left-associative. Both operands must be `int`; the
result is `int`.
